name: BRONZE_SERPENT_STANDARD
canonical: a tall straight rough-hewn bare wooden pole planted upright, with a single cast bronze serpent MOUNTED ON TOP at the very summit — its body raised and its head lifted high like a banner. The long lower shaft is completely BARE plain wood; the serpent does NOT spiral, wind or coil down the pole. A serpent SET UPON a pole (Num 21:8), lifted up — NOT a snake-wrapped staff, NOT the Rod of Asclepius, NOT a medical caduceus, NOT an occult charm
